title: mints oddjob crafting recipe's
description: datapack that adds all sorts of crafting recipe's (chain armor, spawners, heads, ect.)
body:
![3D minecraft title with text saying "MINT'S ODDJOB (FOR FUN, NOT BALANCE!) RECIPE BOOK"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f8c61d6bf2f79a7904957c1d8873a10f4af2c2a.png)

**mint's oddjob recipe book is a datapack filled to the brim with crafting recipe's _(in fact, it's 200 recipe's exactly!)_** 

## **What you can expect from this datapack:**

- a bunch of coral-based crafting recipe's _(changing coral types with dye, crafting different types of coral, turning coral into dye, ect.)_
- previously uncraftable items being craftable _(spawners, sponges, sculk blocks, discs, enchanted golden apples, ect.)_
- dust/powder/sugar conversion crafts _(ex. turning gunpowder into redstone with red dye.)_
- a bunch of more... wacky crafts _(flint + sticks = charcoal, putting ores back into stone/deepslate, ect.)_

**_NOTE: it is important to say that this is not any sort of attempt to "fix" minecraft's crafting system in any way, a good amount of these recipe's were made on whim without me thinking too hard about balance!_**
